title: Ws client message
description: The only two frames a browser may send on GET /ws. `subscribe` narrows the frame types the socket receives; `ping` keeps the socket alive and is answered by nothing. Commands never travel over the socket: they are REST posts validated with api-sim-command. The default subscription is every ws-server-message type except telemetry.samples, which a client has to ask for by name.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: A frame type of ws-server-message; the two enums are asserted equal in test/ws-api.test.ts.

channel_list.title: Channel list
channel_list.description: The frame types the socket wants from now on. An empty list mutes every channel.

oneOf.description: Replace the subscription of this socket with the named channels.
Keep the socket alive. The frame carries nothing else.

type.description: Which of the two client frames this is.
